lines: d41: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Jae Ochoa is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
d41: Nobody's talking much. The fire feels smaller tonight.
d41: 🕯️ Jae is dead — and the dead hold no treaties. Every link Haven has shakes.

d41: Stonebridge watches to see if Haven holds without its dead. The bond is young — they're still deciding what Haven is, and grief delays the verdict. They'll test the link — count on it, unless Haven answers first: send grain (1,500 kcal), send a speaker (2 days), or let the silence answer. (Trust -8.
d41: 🕯️ Jae Ochoa is dead — the expedition. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
d41: What Jae kept close goes into the ground with them — keepsakes are buried, never taken from the body.
d41: "Jae's gone." Aurora looks at you for a long moment. "You're not Jae." No heat in it. Just fact. You'll have to earn this face.
d41: The Codex doesn't pause for grief. Sam blinks — and it's already there, overlaying everything, syncing. No pen. No paper. The mantle just... transfers.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Calming Panic (Level 1). Ground them: 5 things you see, 4 you hear, 3 you touch. Breathe with them. Slow is fast.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Generous Heart (Level 1). Donating gives 2x trust.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Animal Behavior (Level 1). Most animals flee. Give them an escape route and they take it. Cornered animals fight.
d41: 🌟 "MANTLE TRANSFER DETECTED. ...Oh! New face! Same job! Whole new set of tricks. We hardly noticed. (That is a lie. We noticed. The audience CRIED.)"
d41: 📖 The Codex turns a page: Jae Ochoa, 41 days. The mantle passes to Sam Jiang.
d41: 🪞 You wake up somebody else. Sam Jiang, 37 — an emergency dispatcher. His hands know different work now: Green Whisper, Echo Location.
d41: The village's quarrel was with Jae — and Jae is dead. The sentence doesn't cross the grave. You're someone else now; the docket is empty, but the village remembers.
d41: At the grave, Eric, June, Maeve and 6 more speak for Sam — "Jae trusted them. We saw it. Give them the fire's hearing." The village listens.
d41: The fire knew Sam before the Codex did — his name already carried weight here.
